findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "fx_symbols" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: FX symbols: the list of currencies with daily European Central Bank reference rates (about 30), each with its ISO 4217 code and English name, plus how many pair…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "prices" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stock_history, defi_yield_history · Private data: token_report, token, wallet_audit, contract_risk, liquidity_pool_audit, price_token, price_tokens, wallet_portfolio, pack_token_analysis, trade_insight, polymarket_markets, polymarket_orderbook, polymarket_price_history, token_verdict, token_supply, token_buyers, dex_trending, hyperliquid_account, defi_yields · Public sink: dex_trending.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stock_history, defi_yield_history · Private data: token_report, token, wallet_audit, contract_risk, liquidity_pool_audit, price_token, price_tokens, wallet_portfolio, pack_token_analysis, trade_insight, polymarket_markets, polymarket_orderbook, polymarket_price_history, token_verdict, token_supply, token_buyers, dex_trending, hyperliquid_account, defi_yields · Public sink: dex_trending

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "pack_crypto_market" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Market sentiment, prices and signals in one call: the Fear & Greed index with its 7-day change (alternative.me, attributed), the 10 most traded Hyperliquid perpetuals with price, 24-hour change, funding and open interest, technical readings (RSI, MACD, moving averages) for up to three coins, and Bit" → after: "Market sentiment, prices and signals in one call: the Fear & Greed index with its 7-day change (alternative.me, attributed), the 10 most traded Hyperliquid perpetuals with price, 24-hour change, funding and open interest, technical readings (RSI, MACD, moving averages) for up to three coins, and Bit"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
